# src/nofluke/strategies/

Candidate-proposing strategies: the `Strategy` interface and `History` a strategy sees, the built-in random strategy,
the Latin-hypercube design used for every study's first candidates, and the registry (`get_strategy`) that maps a
config's `strategy.name` to an implementation.

Folder rules: a strategy proposes one candidate from (history, rng, index) and draws only from the rng it is given;
optional backends (Optuna) live in their own module and are imported lazily by the registry.

<!-- docmap:begin (generated by tools/docmap.py; do not edit) -->
| Entry | What it is | Imported by |
|---|---|---|
| `__init__.py` | Strategy registry: `get_strategy(config)` returns the candidate-proposing strategy a study asked for. | `planner`, `study` |
| `base.py` | Strategy interface: the `History` a strategy sees and the `Strategy` base class that proposes one candidate. | `strategies`, `random` |
| `lhs.py` | Latin-hypercube design for the first `n_init` candidates of every study (D11). | `planner` |
| `random.py` | Random-search strategy: every candidate is a uniform draw from the search space. | `strategies` |
